nomen.name: Multipipe
nomen.info: Create a multipipe with a constant radius from a set of curves.

inputs.name: Curves
inputs.info: The curve network to pipe. Curve discontinuities and end-points become nodes.

inputs.name: Radius
inputs.info: Radius of multipipe surface across all the nodes.

inputs.name: Bulge
inputs.info: Radius multiplier along the pipes connecting the nodes. Factors below 1.0 pinch, values above 1.0 bulge.

inputs.name: Transition
inputs.info: Size of the transition from a node into its pipes, as a factor of the radius. Zero omits the transition section entirely, leading to a smoother result.

inputs.name: Segment Spacing
inputs.info: Optional approximate spacing of loops along each connecting pipe. If not specified, no additional edge loops are added.

inputs.name: Kink Angle
inputs.info: Maximum angle between consecutive segments along curves and across nodes.

inputs.name: Cube Insertion
inputs.info: Tendency to fit a cube at near-orthogonal nodes, from `0 = never` to `1 = most often`.

nomen.name: Varying Multipipe
nomen.info: Create a multipipe with varying radii from a set of curves.

inputs.name: Radius Points
inputs.info: Locations where a radius is specified. Radii across all unspecified nodes are interpolated.

inputs.name: Radii
inputs.info: Radius of multipipe surface at each of the radius nodes.

inputs.name: Bulge
inputs.info: Radius multiplier along the connecting pipes. Factors below 1.0 pinch, values above 1.0 bulge.

inputs.name: Transition
inputs.info: Size of the transition from a node into its pipes, as a factor of the node radius. Zero omits the transition section entirely, leading to a smoother result.

inputs.name: Segment Spacing
inputs.info: Optional approximate spacing of loops along each connecting pipe. If not specified, no additional edge loops are added.

inputs.name: Kink Angle
inputs.info: Maximum angle between consecutive segments along curves and across nodes.

inputs.name: Cube Insertion
inputs.info: Tendency to fit a cube at near-orthogonal nodes, from `0 = never` to `1 = most often`.

inputs.name: Closed
inputs.info: If true, the surface will be closed in the direction of the sweep. Leave blank to inherit the closed state from the rail curves.

inputs.info: If true, the sweep surface will be vertically scaled to reduce variations in the height of the resulting surface.
